title: Turkish Yogurt Flatbread
description: A simple Turkish-inspired recipe that combines the tanginess of yogurt with the crunch of flatbread.
instructions: Cut the flatbreads into quarters or sixths, depending on desired size.
In a small bowl, mix together yogurt, olive oil, garlic, and salt.
Dip each flatbread piece into the yogurt mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Place the coated flatbreads on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the flatbreads are crispy and golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
